And this is my cousin, Aleema.|Aleema|We are interested in seeing any old artifacts from the dark side. If you have any.|Curator|If I ''have'' any?? My dears, you're in luck! We're just now installing a new exhibit. &#39;''The Dark Lords of the Sith''.&#39;|attr=Satal and Aleema Keto, speaking with the museum curator|audio=Exhibit1-TotJ.flac|src=<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
In [[3998 BBY]], the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Museum of Dark Side Antiquities]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] organized a presentation for display to the public entitled '''''The Dark Lords of the Sith'''''. Located within the Museum's [[Sith Hall]], the exhibit was dedicated exclusively to the history of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and its rulers, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]] of the eponymous [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

In the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of its inception, ''The Dark Lords of the Sith'' exhibit was patronized by [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], two [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|socialite]] cousins native to the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]]. Despite the insignificance of the exhibit's [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] as purported by the [[Galactic Museum curator|museum curator]], the Ketos' interest in [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash;oriented objects led them to steal an ancient [[Sith spellbook/Legends|Sith spellbook]] from a display. With the knowledge they gained from its contents, Aleema and Satal became influential in the resurgence of the actual Dark Lords of the Sith, for whom the museum exhibit was named.

==Description==
{{Dialogue|Curator|I'm afraid the exhibit's not quite ready yet.|Aleema|Oh, but couldn't we see what you've got anyway?|Curator|Well, I'm not supposed to&hellip;most of the stuff we have is just rubbish, you know? But the Jedi Knights asked us not to display it until the proper security measures have been taken.|Aleema|Just a peek? Please??|Curator|Welllll&hellip;all right. What harm is it, anyway? Just a bunch of old books and talismans collecting dust. Not as though anybody can use these things to take over the galaxy or anything! Right through here!|Aleema|Ohhh&hellip;|Satal|Wow.|Curator|Here it is, just piles of old books and medallions so far. But wait until we set up the lights and the holographs. That's the real show.|attr=Satal and Aleema Keto, speaking with the museum curator|audio=Exhibit2-TotJ.flac|src=<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
[[File:MuseumBrowse-TFNU1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Patrons admiring a Sith artifact display.]]
Within the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Museum of Dark Side Antiquities]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="TOTJC" /> was an exhibit<ref name="FNU1" /> titled ''The Dark Lords of the Sith''. The presentation was in a cordoned-off section<ref name="TOTJA" /> of the Museum's [[Sith Hall]], which was more than forty levels below Coruscant's [[City/Legends|cityscape]].<ref name="TOTJC" /> While the entirety of the exposition was dedicated to the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Sith (species)/Legends|namesake species]], a particular area concerned the history of its rulers: the infamous [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]]. The presentation featured many tables and display cases replete with weapons, [[Book/Legends|books]], and various other types of [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] that once belonged to the Dark Lords. Several of the heirlooms radiated with the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] within close proximity to them were able to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] their potency. Earthenware sculptures lined the exhibit's walls and adorned the halls, and included informational placards that gave insight into the forgotten splendor of the Dark Lords of the Sith.<ref name="FNU1" /> A separate room temporarily housed piles of old books and [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]] that were waiting to be placed in their respective locations. The [[Galactic Museum curator|museum curator]] intended to further augment the exhibit with special lighting effects and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic projections]] that told stories of the Sith's fabled [[Golden Age of the Sith|Golden Age]].<ref name="TOTJA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Do you know much about the dark side?''"<br />"''Oh, just what's here on the datapad, really. Ancient Jedi Knights who turned to the dark side became Dark Lords of the Sith&hellip;or some such nonsense.|Satal Keto and the museum curator|audio=Exhibit3-TotJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
In [[3998 BBY]], the curator of the Museum of Dark Side Antiquities on Coruscant was nearing the completion of an exhibit in the Museum's Sith Hall titled ''The Dark Lords of the Sith''. It was during the final stages of construction<ref name="TOTJA" /> that [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]], [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|socialite]] cousins from the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], arrived on Coruscant, hoping to satisfy their curiosity for dark side objects.<ref name="FNU1" /> Their search led them to the Galactic Museum, where they were directed toward the Sith Hall and its collection of dark side artifacts. Pretending to be innocent tourists, the Ketos met with the curator and requested access to the exhibit. The curator at first denied them, stating that the presentation was still in its production stages. When the Ketos asked the curator again for permission to view the artifacts despite its incompleteness, he again refused them, this time citing explicit instructions from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to restrict access to anyone until the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] themselves were able to implement an adequate security detail to police the exhibit.<ref name="TOTJA" />

[[File:FreedonNaddGalacticMuseum-TFNU1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''The Dark Lords of the Sith'' exhibit debuted in 3998 BBY.]]

While the dark side nature of the collected materials concerned the Jedi, the museum's curator was skeptical about the power each item possessed; he believed that they were nothing more than worthless antiquities and mused that it was highly improbable that anyone could use any of them to conquer [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When Aleema asked a final time to just be allowed to glance at the items, the curator relented. He led both her and Satal into an adjacent room with more tables and display cases, as well as piles of ancient texts and [[Sith talisman/Legends|talismans]]. The Ketos were fascinated by the exhibit's contents, but the curator dismissed the artifacts as insignificant; he had yet to complete the presentation with the holographic and special effect lighting that he was sure would become the exhibit's main attraction. Aleema then asked the curator the extent of his own dark side knowledge, to which he confessed was nonexistent. He instead deferred to a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that gave a brief overview of the origins of the Dark Lords of the Sith and the long-forgotten civilization over which they ruled. The trio was interrupted at that moment by a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] message for the curator, who excused himself while allowing the Ketos to peruse the exhibit unaccompanied.<ref name="TOTJA" />

Instantly the two Force-sensitive youths were buffeted by the dark side power they felt resonating from the exhibit's collection of artifacts, something they guessed no one else was aware of. Recognizing the significance of their find, Aleema pressed Satal to steal something.<ref name="TOTJA" /> He obliged,<ref name="FNU1" /> taking advantage of the curator's preoccupation to pilfer a [[Sith spellbook/Legends|Sith spellbook]] from a table. The Ketos then quickly departed the museum with their new prize, leaving the curator, who returned to the room shortly afterward, wondering where the pair of inquisitive visitors had disappeared to.<ref name="TOTJA" /> The spellbook that was stolen from ''The Dark Lords of the Sith'' exhibit by Satal and Aleema began their initiation into the ways of the dark side.<ref name="FNU2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref> With it, they subsequently learned to harness ancient [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], and eventually became powerful [[Sith sorcerer|sorcerers]]<ref name="DLOTSA">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref> who joined forces with several other agents of the Sith to incite the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TSW">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''</ref> Thus, contrary to the belief of the museum curator,<ref name="TOTJA" /> an item from ''The Dark Lords of the Sith'' exhibit was a major contribution to the return of the Sith<ref name="FNU2" /> and their campaign to conquer the galaxy.<ref name="TSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Dark Lords of the Sith'' exhibit first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] story arc, ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]'', written by authors [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. In the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]], the exhibit is not named and appears only as a wing of Coruscant's Galactic Museum.<ref name="FNU1" /> [[John Whitman]]'s [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|audio adaptation]] of ''Tales of the Jedi'' first identifies the section of the museum in which the Ketos are seen browsing as "''The Dark Lords of the Sith''" exhibit.<ref name="TOTJA" />

In the audio drama, Satal and Aleema Keto locate the Museum of Dark Side Antiquities and are met by its curator, who then guides them to the exhibit where they later steal the spellbook.<ref name="TOTJA" /> In the comic version, however, the Ketos locate the museum, which is simply called the Galactic Museum, after browsing a tourist guide. The exhibit is never named, and they never interact with the museum's curator, but instead explore the museum's Sith Hall for themselves.<ref name="FNU1" />
